notes.title: About the Update and Save Game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/127b11eb266d44a2c1526e099ffd28dec1fff5c7.png[/img]
Dear heroes of my heart, as you may know, a new update will be released on December 24th. Before anything else, I want to sincerely apologize for the long wait in bringing you this update, and I deeply appreciate your patience and support throughout these years. Truly, thank you from the bottom of my heart. <3

Now, let’s get into the details of this post:

[olist]
[*] [b]Save Game:[/b] As you can see, this update is packed with a lot of content—it’s the result of nearly two years of work. Because of this, many changes had to be made, and one of them is the Save System. I understand this might upset some players, but starting December 24th with this major update, everyone will need to start a new game.However, I promise it will be worth it! This update brings a ton of new features, giving you a fresh and exciting experience when you start again. Rest assured, your achievements and cards will remain intact—you won’t lose those. I truly appreciate everyone’s understanding.
[/olist]
These is the key points I wanted to share with you. If you have any questions or curiosities about the update, I’ll be available to answer them here and in the announcement over the coming days.

Thank you, heroes! See you on December 24th—I’ll make sure everything is perfect for launch so you can have an amazing gaming experience. Love you all!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/baac95773b6eafd9df4fb3b2cfeb92c13ea3567b.png[/img]

notes.title: The Company and Our Games
notes.notes:
Hello heroes, how’s everyone doing? The long-awaited update for Who Needs a Hero? is finally arriving, and I want to apologize once again for the delay. As many of you know, we are a two-person company, and our first game is Who Needs a Hero?, which we’ve been developing since 2021. To give you a little insight into our plans, our idea is to develop more games, all within the Who Needs a Hero? universe. We believe this universe is incredibly rich and fun, and it would be a shame to stop at just one game. We want to create several games in this immersive and comedic world.

That said, I know many of you aren’t fans of mobile games, but I’d like to share our other game, which is also set in the same universe and features the same characters. If you'd like to try it and support us there as well, I’d be very grateful. It’s a great way to pass the time while waiting for December 24th to arrive. If you’re interested, the name of the game is [b]Hero Hero Clicker[/b], currently available on [b][url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.babystone.heroheroclicker]Google Play[/url], the [url=https://apps.apple.com/br/app/hero-hero-clicker-idle-game/id6474022305]Apple Store[/url], and Samsung Galaxy Store.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/242a2efb21ea1820422c462a9304d8a733664cb7.jpg[/img]

Thank you for everything, and I hope you can continue to support us on this journey. To be honest, my dream is for Who Needs a Hero? to become a TV series. Imagine how amazing that would be! "Netflix announces the new TV series Who Needs a Hero?" Sounds like a dream, right? But I believe it will happen one day.

That’s all for now. Thank you, heroes! Let’s keep moving forward. See you on December 24th!

notes.title: Clarification Note!
notes.notes:
Hello heroes of Who Needs a Hero! How is everyone doing?

I would like to thank you for your continuous support and patience over the past years. We know that many of you are eagerly awaiting a new update on Steam, and we understand how much it can enhance the game and provide more hours of gameplay.

Our team consists only of me and a programmer, and unfortunately, we cannot dedicate all our time to the game's development. Currently, we are working on it only in our spare time, which is why it has taken so long to bring you new content.

However, I want you to know that I highly value your support and I am truly grateful. We are doing our best to bring the Steam update to you as soon as possible. While we cannot make specific promises at this time, we are committed to offering you an increasingly better experience.

Thank you for your understanding and support thus far. We will do our utmost to repay the trust you have placed in us. Please feel free to reach out to us via email or message whenever you wish.

And don't worry, we will soon share a new announcement showcasing everything that is coming in the next Steam update! Home system, character customization, and a new storyline!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/c5b6b6b32452f834d9bbb934ad65f4b64bbf4ec2.png[/img]

I wish you all the best and hope you continue to enjoy playing Who Needs a Hero!

Lov u all <3

Sincerely,
Henrique

notes.title: Hero Tournament Update!
notes.notes:
[u][b][h3]The Hero Tournament update is alive![/h3][/b][/u]
We are pleased to announce that the new update HERO TOURNAMENT is NOW AVAILABLE!!! (I'm gonna cry haha)

The Hero Tournament update brings an exciting inventory systems and a new funny and challenging story!  Who Needs a Hero is a text-based game with RPG elements, and WE LOVE RPG! So fortunately this update comes with a huge improvement and enhancements for your experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/036439a64b37f250c0de6de72598402b241d951b.png[/img]

So to bring this new experience for you, [b][u] we had to take a hard decision to reset your save games.[/u][/b] The reason is because this new update was [b]no longer compatible with the previous version[/b] of the game. It's crucial that you start a new game, since the merchant and new characters will show early on. I really hope you understand, I'm really sorry!  Lov you all heroes <3 

Enough small talk, and lets to the update!

[u][b][h3]What's new?[/h3][/b][/u]
[u][b]Inventory and Shopping![/b][/u]

For a better use of your coins and followers, we're adding a inventory system with 20 unique and comic items. Heroes will be able to buy items with gold coins, and those who want to be a evil hero, there's the black market to trade your followers for items too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/4bf6687aa86de99c2c817f22cb37568263ae9b85.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/27564b080789e78869c3f23bd043e407f74c9082.png[/img]

The items will have different effects such as: Increase your health, increase your strength, roll more dice in battles, evolve your pet, unlock new customs, unlock new dialogues, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/19ad69e00a01282325a9a669e1757808fff290c9.png[/img]


[u][b]A New Story! New Characters![/b][/u]

We're adding 30 new characters with their own dialogues and story! Not all characters are listed below, but I know you will unlock everyone as a true hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/e14d2abe9d798c1ccaf87d0e029c7a8fc4253436.png[/img]

[u][b]4 New Scenarios[/b][/u]

There will be 4 new scenarios: Underworld, Capital, Arena and Ocean. It's time to cross the Ocean, visit the Underworld to get stronger, buy items in the Capital and battle in the Arena to become the strongest hero in the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/875ad68c2b67dcfedb6637c5050d3b059a48525b.png[/img]

[b][u]A New Ultra Legendary Sword[/u][/b]

We're adding a new pog sword with a new feature. You will be able to enchant your Raw Sword with four Rare Gems: Fire, Ice, Fire and Ice, Dark. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/640883e88353eff878395272511ea2dbb3e33ebc.png[/img]

Each gem has an unique skin and status/effect. And of course, a nice description for each one!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/b0638721c62543b724c78c6d5e2e225ff23dcc8e.png[/img]

[b][u]More customization and mounts to ride![/u][/b]

We're adding 5 new color and hairstyles, a new system to customize your armor color. And we cant forget about the mount to ride! But don't forget, to unlock certain mounts you need to choose wisely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/e78ce53ede6c881bcec837efe3c7648c35fd2f83.png[/img]

[u][b][h3]Quick word and future plans[/h3][/b][/u]
We still have a lot of ideas that we want to implement, ideas that have already been posted here on Steam before. But we decided to go slower, we're always reading your feedback and reviews. So after this update, based on your feedback, we'll be studying the best features to be added in the next major update.

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]: As I mentioned earlier, [u][b]this is a new game that's no more compatible with the previous version. So all save games were reset.[/b][/u] please don't be mad with me, I always want the best for you <3

[u][b][h3]Next Update coming soon![/h3][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Germany and Russian language
[*] DLC 18+ with new hot images from the new characters
[*] Save Slots
[*] New UI to change your mount during the main menu
[*] More dialogues to the Chat Followers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38063580/c2a458be8a02e5f993f1c5b2bcddb75a114b4254.png[/img]
And don't forget to join our Hero Army! We're a family and would love to have you there!

You're the real heroes! Lov u all!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Available NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OvGHwvl.png[/img]

Hello heroes of Grimar! How are you doing? 

The new “Who Needs a Hero?” update is here! ːsteamhappyː

📢 [b]NOTE:[/b] If you're not a new player and your level character is 100+, be sure to read the quote at the end.

[b]NEW FEATURES![/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can [b]marry Juliet,[/b] the busty elven woman! (PS: She looks even more beautiful in a wedding dress). ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː
[*] Play as a [b]Girl[/b] now! This doesn’t change anything other than your appearance.
[*] Use the Beast Master skill to [b]tame a pet[/b] that will follow you during your journey. (Maybe a baby *****?).
[*] It’s time to fly on a Dragon! Now you can use the Riding skill to [b]ride a dragon![/b] At least you could try.
[*] Now the Demon Blood Relic gives you a [b]demon wing[/b] if you became a demon!
[/list]

[b]NEW CONTENT![/b]
[list]
[*] 20 new characters with their own dialogues.
[*] 2 new locations! Under the Sea and Lava Cave. (It’s time to find out if mermaids really exist)
[*] Added a legendary armor and a new sword!
[*] 6 new haircuts with 3 new colors.
[*] 2 new skin colors.
[*] 6 new enemies.
[*] Added 4 new relics (Elf Wedding Ring, Dragon Scale, Love Letter, Golden Ruby)
[*] Improved scenario effects.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6w9cx2y.png[/img]

[b]FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the skill Ancient Wise and Lockpick did not increase the success rate.
[*] Fixed text issues.
[*] Fixed the alchemist’s dialogue, now you’ll be able to research about immortality and infinite money
[*] Fixed the Lord of Fight’s dialogue that prevented you from making the last battle in the arena.
[*] Balance changes: we decreased the power of a few enemies.
[*] Performance Improvements
[/list]

📢 [b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b] If you're not a new player and your level character is 100+, I recommend that you start a New Game to see all the new content. The reason is because I’m always reading your reviews and a lot of people found the game repetitive after level 40+. So this update was made mainly from levels 40 to 80. You may wish to continue your game, but you’ll not see all the content. I’m really sorry guys! Hope you understand ːsteamsadː

I’d like to thank you all for the patience, support and feedback. We’ll continue working to improve the game and add more content. lov u all <3

You’re the real Heroes!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE IS COMING! ON FEBRUARY!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, hope you're doing well! 

We are always reading your reviews on steam, and we want to improve the game based on them. 

Then we will do a [b]quick update[/b] to fix this as soon as possible. Here is the [b]list of improvements[/b]:

[olist]
[*] The same dialogue will not appear more than 3 times. This will make the game not so repetitive, and you will have more chance to see all the characters and events.

[*] Four new hair and colors. 

[*]  Two new skin colors.

[*] Two new scenarios.

[*]  Ten new characters and three new enemies.

[*]  You'll be able to play as a Girl now! This doesn’t change anything other than your appearance.

[*]  You'll be able to have a Pet now, that will follow you during your journey ːsteamhappyː

[*]  You finally will be able to marry the Elf Girl if you want ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː

[*]  Bug Fixes (Now you'll be able to kill the homunculus with the Fireball).
[/olist]

After this update, we'll start to work in a huge update. Adding more features and mechanics that you're asking ːsteamhappyː Thank you everyone for the support so far. Love you all!
